public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Ben Green's Open Problem 81

Let $A$ be a set of size $n$ integers. Is there some absolute constant $c > 0$ and $\theta$
such that $\sum_{a \in A} \cos(a \theta) \leq - c \sqrt{n}$?

*References:*
- [Ben Green's Open Problem 81](https://people.maths.ox.ac.uk/greenbj/papers/open-problems.pdf#section.11)
- [erdosproblems.com/510](https://www.erdosproblems.com/510)

This file points to the canonical formalization in `FormalConjectures.ErdosProblems.«510»`.
-/

@[expose] public section

reformulations.difference: The canonical theorem imported by this pointer module uses a strict inequality and only sufficiently large cardinalities, rather than the customary non-strict bound for every nonempty set of positive integers.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: Strict and non-strict bounds are interchangeable by shrinking the existential positive constant, since sqrt(N)>0 for N>0. The sufficiently-large restriction is also harmless: every nonempty positive-frequency cosine sum f with n terms has min f ≤ -1/2. Indeed, writing m=-min f, one has (f+m)(n-f)≥0; normalized integration, using ∫f=0 and ∫f²=n/2, gives m≥1/2. This uniform bound handles the finitely many excluded cardinalities after reducing the constant. The strict/non-strict equivalence was proved in Lean; the full finite-exception argument was checked mathematically.

sources_consulted: https://people.maths.ox.ac.uk/greenbj/papers/open-problems.pdf#section.11 — Problem 81, its comments and references, p. 38.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.05260 — Benjamin Bedert, Polynomial bounds for the Chowla Cosine Problem; version history through v3, 24 July 2026.
https://arxiv.org/e-print/2509.05260 — v3 LaTeX source: introduction, main theorem, general-coefficient remarks, and the explicit intermediate bound K(n) ≫ n^(1/7).
https://eudml.org/doc/278427 — bibliographic record for Ruzsa, Negative values of cosine sums.
review.notes: 81.lean contains no local mathematical declarations or status attributes: it is a documented public import of ErdosProblems/510.lean. The imported main statement and two variants were inspected as context. The positive-integer domain agrees with the explicit Chowla formulation in Bedert's paper; its square-root bound remains open, while both recorded weaker bounds are supported. Scratch Lean checks confirmed the quantifier types, satisfiable cardinality hypotheses, empty/zero/singleton behavior, and strict/non-strict equivalence. The live erdosproblems.com/510 page returned Cloudflare challenges despite descriptive User-Agent headers, so its current remarks/status could not be independently read. Ruzsa's publisher full-text link was also inaccessible; the bound is explicitly corroborated in Bedert's introduction. No changes were made to the repository.
